idea: Safety – BUCKLE UP in the car seat (THE FAMILY CAR back seat, Ava in HOME outfit, in her pink car seat; timely for Thanksgiving travel): hook 'Oh no! No seatbelt!' – Ava gasps at the open straps and the empty red buckle; step 1 'Arms in, arms in! One, two!' – straps over her shoulders; step 2 'Click, click! Buckle up!' – she pushes the clips into the red buckle; copy-me 'Clap, clap, click! Clap with me!'; step 3 'Snug and safe! Pat, pat, pat!' – she pats the snug straps; chorus 'Buckle up, buckle up! Safe in my seat!'; question to the viewer 'In the car, what do we do? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'Buckle up! Yay!'; review 'Click, click! Buckle up with me!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now fully buckled, bye-bye wave.
place_block: THE FAMILY CAR: the cozy back seat of the family's friendly light blue car, soft light gray seats, a side window with sunshine, green trees and blue sky outside, no logos and no text.

learning.goal: Always buckle up in your car seat (Wed slot 2 – Safety: seatbelt)
learning.shown_how: open straps + empty red buckle (hook) -> straps over shoulders -> buckled with click sound + sparkle -> pats snug straps -> fully buckled loop
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18 'In the car, what do we do? Hmm?', humming pause 0:19-0:22, answer 'Buckle up! Yay!' 0:22
learning.copy_me: Clap, clap, click! Clap with me! (0:09) + pat pat pat (0:12)
learning.fact_check: buckled frames show all clips inside the red buckle (f4/f5 regenerated once: first versions had loose side clips)
learning.modeling: the baby is always buckled before the trip; description reminds grown-ups to check the straps
learning.toddler_fit: one baby, calm car interior, nothing scary, face big

story_order.buckled: absent shots 1-2, from the click cut (0:06.3) on
